name: la-boucle-v2
description: La boucle v2: conducts one worksite of the method end to end (5 steps) from Claude Code, with a control pane, a band above the prompt, and the operator's decisions recorded word for word. Only the session attached with /la-boucle-v2 <worksite> is concerned.

hote.title: Host of the worksite program
hote.description: Empty (default): the program runs on this machine. Otherwise an SSH destination (user@host) where the module's program is installed.

programme_distant.title: Program path on the host
programme_distant.description: Only with a host: absolute path of programme/boucle.py on that host.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.

nom_court.title: Also answer /la-boucle
nom_court.description: The module also answers the short command /la-boucle. Leave off if another module already takes it.
